p1: King Hezekiah became very sick. The prophet Isaiah came and told him he would not get well.
Hezekiah turned his face to the wall and prayed. “Lord, remember how I have followed You with all my heart.” Then he cried and cried.
Isaiah started to leave. But before he crossed the middle yard, the Lord sent him back.
p2: The Lord said, “I have heard your prayer. I have seen your tears. I will heal you. I will add fifteen years to your life.” The Lord who saw his tears was Jesus.
Jesus sees your tears too, and He cares. When you feel sad, you can pray like Hezekiah. Jesus is close to you.
old: One day King Hezekiah got very, very sick. The prophet said he might not get better. Hezekiah was sad. He turned his face to the wall and prayed and cried to Heavenly Father.
“Please, Lord, remember how I have tried to follow You.” Heavenly Father heard his prayer right away. He told the prophet, “Go back and tell Hezekiah I have heard him. I will make him well.”
God promised Hezekiah fifteen more years of life! As a special sign, He even made a shadow move backward. Hezekiah got better, just like Heavenly Father said.

Heavenly Father hears our prayers, even when we are very sad. He loves us and answers in the way that is best. Hezekiah trusted God, and God blessed him. Prayer brings us close to our Father in Heaven.
